_extraction_flags.notes: EXCLUDE: Pure communication paper (S-CADD receiver optimization for short-reach interconnects/DCI). No sensing functionality described or demonstrated. 'Integrated Sensing and Communication' appears only in the author affiliation/lab name. Visual analysis file mismatch (describes VLC positioning), identifying based on text.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Text Figures description: Fig.1: S-CADD receiver structure. Fig.2: Pairwise coding principle. Fig.3: Simulation setup (80km SSMF, 16QAM OFDM). Fig.4-6: BER vs OSNR/CSPR curves. (Note: visual_analysis.txt describes a VLC positioning system, which completely contradicts the paper text title and content. Relying on text.)
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Short-reach optical communication receiver (S-CADD). Technique: Pairwise Coding (PWC) to mitigate color SNR effect in direct detection. Application: Data Center Interconnects.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 256 Gbps (64 Gbaud 16-QAM) over 80 km SSMF. OSNR gain 1.5 dB. No sensing metrics (Range, Resolution) reported.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Improved BER/OSNR for direct detection of complex DSB signals. Gap: Relevant for optical comms, but irrelevant for ISAC/O-ISAC.

bibliographic.title: Performance Improvement for Symmetric Carrier-assisted Differential Detection Receiver by Pairwise Coding
bibliographic.authors: Zihua Huang, Jianping Li, Xinkuo Yu, Jianqing He, Yuwen Qin, Meng Xiang, Songnian Fu

application.scenario_description: Short-reach optical interconnects (DCI) using advanced direct detection.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Pairwise coding (PWC) scheme for S-CADD receiver to improve resilience against color noise in direct detection of DSB signals.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: S-CADD suffers from SNR imbalance across subcarriers due to transfer function nulls.

receiver.notes: S-CADD receiver: 90 deg hybrid + delay line + BPDs. Field recovery from direct detection.

comm_metrics.notes: 256 Gbps raw rate. PWC achieves 1.5 dB OSNR gain at 7% FEC threshold.
